jo9_duplicato_traits:
! JO9 MOD START DUPLICATO_ESSENTIA_TRAITS_20261116
! Candidate only. Source is assistant; recipient is slave. No costs, learning flags or progression here.
! pair -> result 1/0. reason,key -> Korean failure reason; an empty key checks the pair only.
! list -> $result is eligible keys separated by |, without leading/trailing |.
! eligible,key -> result 1/0. label,key,role -> $result; optional role is assistant (default) or slave.
! preview,key -> comma-separated removed trait names. removals,key -> | separated removed field keys.
! apply,key -> result 1 on success, 0 without changes when ineligible. Preview removals separately.
! Queries use only local variables. apply writes only recipient talent/discovery and its exact conflicts.
! Existing references: #static_base talent rows; generate_stock gladiatrix exclusion;
! jo9_traits allow/repair_exclusions; jo9_activity_stage remove. No broad actor repair is run.
local $j9de_mode, $j9de_key, $j9de_role
$j9de_mode=$args[0] & $j9de_key=$args[1] & $j9de_role='assistant'
local $j9de_keys='|sport_affinity|expression_affinity|pet_affinity|dressage_affinity|cowSK_affinity|nurse_affinity|service_affinity|cook_affinity|gladiatrix_affinity|enchanter_affinity|art_affinity|music_affinity|calisthenics_affinity|secretary_affinity|'
local $j9de_label, $j9de_reason
local j9de_i, j9de_n, j9de_value
local $j9de_remove, $j9de_names, $j9de_removed_keys, $j9de_old_label
result=0
$result=''
if $args[2]='slave': $j9de_role='slave'
if $j9de_key='sport_affinity': $j9de_label='운동광'
if $j9de_key='expression_affinity': $j9de_label='달변가'
if $j9de_key='pet_affinity': $j9de_label='순종적인 동물'
if $j9de_key='dressage_affinity': $j9de_label='순종적인 말'
if $j9de_key='cowSK_affinity': $j9de_label='미련한 소'
if $j9de_key='nurse_affinity': $j9de_label='타고난 간호사'
if $j9de_key='service_affinity': $j9de_label='타고난 하녀'
if $j9de_key='cook_affinity': $j9de_label='예민한 미각'
if $j9de_key='gladiatrix_affinity': $j9de_label='타고난 투사'
if $j9de_key='enchanter_affinity': $j9de_label='타고난 마법사'
if $j9de_key='art_affinity': $j9de_label='타고난 미적감각'
if $j9de_key='music_affinity': $j9de_label='절대음감'
if $j9de_key='secretary_affinity': $j9de_label='보좌관'
if $j9de_key='calisthenics_affinity':
 $j9de_label='발레리나'
 if dyneval('result='+$j9de_role+"['nymphomania']")>0 and (dyneval('result='+$j9de_role+"['nymphomania_revealed']")>0 or spell_revelio=1): $j9de_label='이국적인 댄서'
 if dyneval('result='+$j9de_role+"['perversion']")>0 and (dyneval('result='+$j9de_role+"['perversion_revealed']")>0 or spell_revelio=1): $j9de_label='이국적인 댄서'
end
if $j9de_mode='label':
 $result=$j9de_label
 exit
end
if slave_state!CONST_INT['slave_exist'] or assistant_state!CONST_INT['slave_exist']:
 $j9de_reason='노예와 조수가 모두 활동 가능한 상태여야 합니다.'
! JO9 MOD START DUPLICATO_OPTIONAL_PERSON_ID_20261117
elseif slave['id']>0 and slave['id']=assistant['id']:
! JO9 MOD END DUPLICATO_OPTIONAL_PERSON_ID_20261117
 $j9de_reason='서로 다른 노예와 조수가 필요합니다.'
elseif slave['jo9_duplicato_received']=1:
 $j9de_reason='이 노예는 이미 듀플리카토 에센티아로 재능을 복사받았습니다.'
elseif slave['<<assistant["id"]>>']<40 or assistant['<<slave["id"]>>']<40:
 $j9de_reason='노예와 조수의 상호 친밀도가 각각 40 이상이어야 합니다.'
end
if $j9de_mode='pair' or ($j9de_mode='reason' and $j9de_key=''):
 if $j9de_mode='pair':
  result=iif($j9de_reason='',1,0)
 else
  $result=$j9de_reason
 end
 exit
end
if $j9de_mode='list':
 if $j9de_reason!'': exit
 local $j9de_scan, $j9de_item, $j9de_list
 $j9de_scan=mid($j9de_keys,2,len($j9de_keys)-2)
 :j9de_list_loop
 $j9de_item=strfind($j9de_scan,'^([^|]+)',1)
 if $j9de_item!'':
  if func('jo9_duplicato_traits','eligible',$j9de_item)=1:
   if $j9de_list!'': $j9de_list+='|'
   $j9de_list+=$j9de_item
  end
  $j9de_scan=mid($j9de_scan,len($j9de_item)+2)
  jump 'j9de_list_loop'
 end
 $result=$j9de_list
 exit
end
if $j9de_reason='' and ($j9de_label='' or instr($j9de_keys,'|'+$j9de_key+'|')=0): $j9de_reason='복사할 수 있는 긍정 재능이 아닙니다.'
if $j9de_reason='':
 if assistant[$j9de_key]<=0 or ($j9de_key='sport_affinity' and assistant[$j9de_key]!1):
  $j9de_reason='조수가 이 긍정 재능을 가지고 있지 않습니다.'
 elseif assistant[$j9de_key+'_revealed']!2 and spell_revelio!1:
  $j9de_reason='아직 발견하지 못한 재능입니다.'
 elseif slave[$j9de_key]>0:
  $j9de_reason='노예가 이미 같은 긍정 재능을 가지고 있습니다.'
 end
end
if $j9de_mode='reason':
 $result=$j9de_reason
 exit
end
if $j9de_reason!'': exit
if $j9de_mode='eligible': result=1 & exit
if $j9de_mode!'preview' and $j9de_mode!'removals' and $j9de_mode!'apply': exit
! Same-key negative values are replaced by +1, and are disclosed in the removal preview.
if slave[$j9de_key]<0: $j9de_remove[j9de_n]=$j9de_key & j9de_n+=1
if $j9de_key='sport_affinity' and slave['cowSK_affinity']>0: $j9de_remove[j9de_n]='cowSK_affinity' & j9de_n+=1
if $j9de_key='cowSK_affinity':
 if slave['sport_affinity']=1: $j9de_remove[j9de_n]='sport_affinity' & j9de_n+=1
 if func('jo9_activity_stage','stage','slave')=2: $j9de_remove[j9de_n]='jo9_work_ethic' & j9de_n+=1
end
if $j9de_key='expression_affinity' and slave['jo9_voice_trait']=1: $j9de_remove[j9de_n]='jo9_voice_trait' & j9de_n+=1
if $j9de_key='gladiatrix_affinity':
 if slave['pet_affinity']>0: $j9de_remove[j9de_n]='pet_affinity' & j9de_n+=1
 if slave['dressage_affinity']>0: $j9de_remove[j9de_n]='dressage_affinity' & j9de_n+=1
 if slave['cowSK_affinity']>0: $j9de_remove[j9de_n]='cowSK_affinity' & j9de_n+=1
elseif $j9de_key='pet_affinity' or $j9de_key='dressage_affinity' or $j9de_key='cowSK_affinity':
 if slave['gladiatrix_affinity']>0: $j9de_remove[j9de_n]='gladiatrix_affinity' & j9de_n+=1
end
j9de_i=0
:j9de_preview_loop
if j9de_i<j9de_n:
 j9de_value=slave[$j9de_remove[j9de_i]]
 $j9de_old_label=$func('jo9_duplicato_traits','label',$j9de_remove[j9de_i],'slave')
 if $j9de_remove[j9de_i]='jo9_work_ethic': $j9de_old_label='워커홀릭'
 if $j9de_remove[j9de_i]='jo9_voice_trait': $j9de_old_label='선천적 벙어리'
 if j9de_value<0:
  if $j9de_remove[j9de_i]='sport_affinity':
   $j9de_old_label='게으름'
  else
   $j9de_old_label+=' (기존 값 '+str(j9de_value)+')'
  end
 end
 if $j9de_names!'': $j9de_names+=', '
 if $j9de_removed_keys!'': $j9de_removed_keys+='|'
 $j9de_names+=$j9de_old_label
 $j9de_removed_keys+=$j9de_remove[j9de_i]
 j9de_i+=1
 jump 'j9de_preview_loop'
end
if $j9de_mode='preview': $result=$j9de_names & exit
if $j9de_mode='removals': $result=$j9de_removed_keys & exit
! Species/vampire markers are untouched: their only forced talent fields are positive
! secretary/enchanter affinities, which do not conflict with any of the fourteen talents.
j9de_i=0
:j9de_apply_loop
if j9de_i<j9de_n:
 if $j9de_remove[j9de_i]='jo9_work_ethic':
  ! Native stage removal clears the activity stage and its active training credit, not the donor.
  gs 'jo9_activity_stage','remove','slave','jo9_work_ethic'
 else
  slave[$j9de_remove[j9de_i]]=0
  if $j9de_remove[j9de_i]!'jo9_voice_trait': slave[$j9de_remove[j9de_i]+'_revealed']=0
 end
 j9de_i+=1
 jump 'j9de_apply_loop'
end
slave[$j9de_key]=1
slave[$j9de_key+'_revealed']=2
result=1
! JO9 MOD END DUPLICATO_ESSENTIA_TRAITS_20261116
